
# Derived Variables {background-color='{{< brand color blue >}}' .bkg-buildings}

## Handling Missing Data Codes {.bkg-trees}

:::{.incremental}
- Often multiple types of missing data in surveys
    - Refused
    - Don't know
    - Valid skip
- ESS uses 7s (7,77,7777), 8s, and 9s as missing data codes
- If we leave them as is, means and statistics will be skewed incorrectly
    - Need to recode missing data values as missing (`NA`)

:::

## Recoding Missing Data {.bkg-trees}

```{r}
#| label: 04-derived-rename-noshow
#| echo: FALSE
ess_raw <- ess_der |> 
  select(cntry:wt1)

ess_der_update <- ess_der
```

```{r}
#| label: 04-derived-recodes
#| code-line-numbers: "|4,5|6-11|11|12-22|22"
#| eval: FALSE
ess_der_update <-
  ess_raw |>
  mutate(
    Happy = if_else(happy %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, happy),
    News = if_else(nwspol %in% c(7777, 8888, 9999), NA, nwspol),
    Volunteer_Factor = case_when(
      volunfp == 1 ~ "Yes",
      volunfp == 2 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Yes", "No")),
    AgeGroup = recode_values(
      agegroup,
      1 ~ '15-24',
      2 ~ '25-34',
      3 ~ '35-44',
      4 ~ '45-54',
      5 ~ '55-64',
      6 ~ '65-74',
      7 ~ '75+'
    ) |>
      fct_reorder(agegroup)
  )

```


## Viewing Recodes on Raw Data {.smaller .bkg-serpent}

```{r}
#| label: 04-derived-raw-count
#| code-line-numbers: "|1|2"
ess_der_update |> 
  count(happy,Happy)

```
